claims.head: Don’t buy Wolf’s slump against the Kraken
claims.body: Wolf has been shaky against the Kraken since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.
claims.nums: 5 starts against Seattle: .871 save percentage · .903 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Wolf’s record against the Kraken.
claims.call: If Wolf starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .903 than to his .871 against the Kraken.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 5 against Seattle, 3,423 shots against everyone else

chips.tip: Wolf: .871 save percentage in 5 starts against Seattle since 2023-24.
Wolf: .903 save percentage against everyone else since 2023-24, on 3,423 shots.

check.rule: held if he starts and his save percentage is closer to his usual than to his record against this team; can't judge if he doesn't start

claims.head: The Kraken give up shots, and the Flames take them
claims.call: The Flames’ shot volume score is at least their usual 110.
claims.see: About 51 shot attempts at 5-on-5, usually around 30 shots on goal on the scoreboard.
claims.body: The Flames shoot from anywhere, and the Kraken are one of the league’s worst at stopping it. The Kraken’s goalie had better be ready from the opening faceoff.
